name: Corgi Labs
long_description: End-to-end suite of fraud detection and prevention solutions, including an analytics product to monitor and understand dispute + fraud metrics, an AI product which highlights transactions for merchants to follow up on, and an AI solution to recommend rules that can be implemented in payment provider platforms (Stripe, Shopify, Adyen) to proactively reduce dispute + fraud rates.
one_liner: AI to increase payment acceptance and reduce fraud for businesses

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer: End-to-end suite of fraud detection and prevention solutions, including an analytics product to monitor and understand dispute + fraud metrics, an AI product which highlights transactions for merchants to follow up on, and an AI solution to recommend rules that can be implemented in payment provider platforms (Stripe, Shopify, Adyen) to proactively reduce dispute + fraud rates.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Saif is the founder of Corgi Labs, where he builds modern fraud and payments intelligence for fast-growing businesses. Previously, Saif was a Data Scientist at Stripe, Google and Facebook (now Meta), and a healthcare economist in an earlier life.
